4_citation_completeness_both_sides.independent_sweep: The workbook was swept directly, without reference to the pair file, for every CO document carrying two leaf legs in different blocks that are equal and opposite to the cent. 208 such pairs exist: 184 move cost between two different destinations and 24 land both legs on the same destination.
4_citation_completeness_both_sides.coverage: Of the 184 cost moving pairs, 177 carry their document number in both files that hold a leg. The seven that do not are the CONTENTSTACK LICENSE stream, 5117595731, 5118078091, 5118497606, 5118999826, 5119457184, 5119891312 and 5120327060, 9,685.00 each and 67,795.00 together, phaseb_b3 rule 18 at Ampol Customer / Ampol Digital against phaseb_b2 rule 38 at TDD / TDD. That family was ruled out of the required list in round three, so it carries no citation requirement and is recorded here only so the position is not lost. The 24 same destination pairs, 726,351.71, are exempt under the round two ruling.
4_citation_completeness_both_sides.family_mirroring: Six families are named in more than one file and all six carry identical document sets. The failure is in a family that phaseb_b2 does not name, finding R4-01.

findings.statement: The ENERGY SOLUTIONS AZURE RECHARGE family does not mirror between the two sides. phaseb_b1's contra entry was extended this issue to the full twelve document stream at 845,475.50. phaseb_b2's contra entry for the same family still names seven documents at -484,940.47 and its note still opens 'Family ENERGY SOLUTIONS AZURE RECHARGE. Seven monthly documents'. This is the same defect the adversary raised at R3-5 for the Power BI Fabric family, which phaseb_b3 fixed this issue by moving from seven documents to eleven; the Azure family was fixed on the phaseb_b1 side only.
findings.proof: The five counterparty legs sit in phaseb_b2 rule 3 and are S16574 at -86,137.51, S16665 at -78,518.14, S16834 at -70,049.50, S16968 at -65,528.00 and S17169 at -60,301.88, together -360,535.03. 484,940.47 plus 360,535.03 equals 845,475.50, the figure phaseb_b1 now carries. The five document numbers do appear elsewhere in phaseb_b2, but for other transactions: four inside rule 2's Sentinel evidence, which lists the 801425 charge and 801482 contra documents, and three inside open B2-O18's Power BI Fabric list. None of those mentions is the Azure recharge pair.
findings.consequence: phaseb_b1's note asserts that the phaseb_b2 side records all twelve numbers and that the entry now mirrors it. That is true of the bare numbers and false of the family: a reader following the Azure family from the phaseb_b2 side sees seven months and 484,940.47 against twelve months and 845,475.50 on the phaseb_b1 side.
findings.remedy: Extend the phaseb_b2 entry to the same twelve documents and -845,475.50, and change 'Seven monthly documents' to twelve. No line placement changes and no total moves; all twelve legs are already captured by rule 3.

3_budget_tab_row_258.result: SIX OF SEVEN RULES STRETCH THE ROW
3_budget_tab_row_258.what_row_258_is: 2026 Budget tab row 258, cost centre ITEUS IT End User Services, cost element 801482, line item 'Software Licences -Microsoft true up', -200,000, vendor Microsoft, detail column 'Project & Visio recharge to users', mapped TDD / TDD with subarea Workplace & Enterprise Tooling.
3_budget_tab_row_258.empirical_test: No line in cost centre APPLH_INFOTECH names Microsoft Project or Visio in column N. The only column N values in the block containing the word PROJECT are the two ACAPPS project lines at B2-O9, one Snowflake project recharge and the pricing optimiser project line; none is the Microsoft Project licence. No Visio line exists anywhere on the software tab. None of the seven rules captures a Project or Visio licence line, so by the stated test every citation of row 258 is applied to other products.

grading.reason: Rule 5 captures MICROSOFT EA, MICROSFT EA, MICROSOFT EAS and MICROSOFT TRUEUP, including '2026 MICROSOFT EAS TRUEUP'. Row 258 sits on the same budget line item as row 257, 'Software Licences -Microsoft true up', which rule 5 cites first alongside row 256. Row 258 is named only as the recharge of that same line item, so the clause is redundant rather than load bearing. Strike it and rows 256 and 257 still carry the rule.

Copilot is a Microsoft 365 add-on. The evidence cites rows 256 to 258 as a block; row 256, Microsoft 365 licensing at 3,660,000, is the witness that carries, and row 258 adds only the recharge form for a different product.
Power Automate is a Microsoft product in the same ITEUS block but is not the true-up line row 258 names. Row 256 carries it.

Think-Cell is not a Microsoft product. Row 258 is used as a shape witness for central purchase recharged to named users, the same move rule 15 made before it was rewritten. Row 264, the Adobe per-user chargeback, is cited alongside and is the better witness for that shape.
Snagit, Camtasia and TechSmith are not Microsoft products. Same shape argument, same row 264 alongside.
Articulate is not a Microsoft product. Same shape argument, same row 264 alongside.
Autodesk and AutoCAD are not Microsoft products. Same shape argument, same row 264 alongside.

3_budget_tab_row_258.materiality: No destination moves. All seven rules land on TDD / TDD and each carries a witness that survives the removal of the row 258 clause: rules 5, 10 and 14 on row 256 or 257, the Microsoft licensing and true-up lines in the same cost centre; rules 24 to 27 on row 264, a genuine non-Microsoft per-user chargeback, and on the 784 mapping-values grammar that rule 15 now uses, under which a per-user licence line follows the centre that holds it with zero exceptions and APPLH_INFOTECH reads TECHNOLOGY DIGITAL & DATA.

findings.statement: Six rules cite 2026 Budget tab row 258 for products the row does not name. Row 258 is the Project and Visio per-user recharge on the Microsoft true-up line item; rules 10 and 14 apply it to Copilot and Power Automate, and rules 24, 25, 26 and 27 apply it to Think-Cell, TechSmith, Articulate and Autodesk. Rule 5 is the one citation that stands, because row 258 sits on the same budget line item that rule 5's own MICROSOFT TRUEUP lines occupy.
findings.proof: Row 258's detail column reads 'Project & Visio recharge to users'. Column N in cost centre APPLH_INFOTECH names no Microsoft Project or Visio licence on any of the 1,430 lines, and none of the 68 lines these six rules capture is a Project or Visio licence.
findings.materiality: No placement changes. The row 258 clause is not load bearing in any of the six: rules 10 and 14 also cite row 256, and rules 24 to 27 also cite row 264 and stand on the 784 mapping-values class witness. The finding is that the row is being read past what it says, which is the reading the adversary broke at rule 15.
findings.remedy: Strike the row 258 clause from rules 10, 14, 24, 25, 26 and 27, leaving row 256 in rules 10 and 14 and row 264 with the mapping-values grammar in rules 24 to 27. Keep it in rule 5. No numbers change.
